decisions.reason: As a flagship, multi-model product line close to the core software and publicly tied to the firm's digital direction, it carries high sunk investment and reputational commitment, so management is likely to persist with it.
It extends existing training and support capabilities for dental customers, and although the public commitment was modest, its fit with the core offering gives management reasons to retain it.
Because it supports the installed base and customer service around the core software, management can justify keeping it despite limited visible commitment at launch.
The analytics dashboard is an in-house software extension aligned with the firm's push toward more digital and efficient practice management, making continued commitment likely.
A complete practice bundle sits very close to the established business and likely reuses existing components, so management has both strategic and commercial reasons to keep it on the market.
The portal is furthest from the firm's core software business and appears to have had the least visible commitment, making it the easiest product to discontinue if results disappoint.
